mapper.insert: insert into article_report (article_id, user_id, reason, created_at) values ( #{articleReport.articleId}, #{articleReport.userId}, #{articleReport.reason}, #{articleReport.createdAt} )
mapper.select: select AR.article_id articleReportArticleId, AR.user_id articleReportUserId, AR.reason articleReportReason, AR.created_at articleReportCreatedAt from article_report AR where AR.article_id = #{articleId} and AR.user_id = #{userId}
